text:
Diego M: Heads-up — SunrisePayments is planning to sunstep CompetitorLambda and wants a short POC. Main asks: mapping of request/response shapes, billing delta estimate, webhook signature differences, and a security questionnaire run-through. Can SE/security help? cc @Lauren SE @Anya Sec
Priya N: Quick clarifying Q: do they use streaming chat or simple completion calls? Also need a sample of their top-250 API calls (anonymized).
Diego M: Mostly single-shot completions and embeddings; a handful of streaming status updates. We'll request logs.
Lauren SE: From presales: procurement is asking whether we can provide a timeboxed flat-fee for the two-week POC to avoid token surprises. We can propose a capped estimate for the trial; production will remain per-token. I'll draft a short POC quote.
Anya Sec: Security checklist items we need to confirm: data residency (eu-west required), SAML for admin console, weekly audit log export, webhook signature validation, and customer-managed KMS preference. Hosted can do IP allowlist + HMAC signatures; Dedicated/Private required for CMK/HSM and mTLS.
RevOps Bot: Note: flat-fee POCs require RevOps approval and a PO. Link: https://redwood.example/revops/poc-guidelines
Lauren SE: Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) semantic parity >= 90% on human spot checks, 2) token-cost delta <= 15% for typical workload, 3) p95 latency < 300ms for single-shot generation, 4) webhook delivery >= 99% with retries.
Priya N: Proposed technical plan (short):
- Day 0: Kickoff, share creds, upload sample prompts.
- Day 1-2: Handshake & auth verification (headers, example cURL, signature mapping).
- Day 3-4: Parity smoke (run ~1k representative prompts side-by-side).
- Day 5: Billing replay to estimate token delta and capped cost.
- Day 6-7: Scale ramp to their p95 to validate SLOs and fallbacks.
Lauren SE: Example snippets to give their eng team:
```
# exchange token
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth/token -d '{"client_id":"SUN-POC","client_secret":"<redacted>"}'
# completion
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-large-1","input":"List my last 5 charges"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
# webhook header example
X-RW-Signature: sha256=... (HMAC-SHA256)
```
Priya N: We'll run automated metrics (BLEU/ROUGE-style, embedding cosine diffs) plus a 30-item human review focusing on UX regressions (currency formats, truncation, hallucination rate).
Anya Sec: Also: confirm TLS mode for callbacks. If they insist on mTLS for webhooks, recommend Dedicated; Hosted can do HMAC+IP allowlist only.
Diego M: They also want a clear mapping from CompetitorLambda's headers to Redwood. CompetitorLambda uses X-CL-Sig and X-CL-Id. Let's include a small mapping table in the handshake doc.
RevOps Bot: Reminder: include expected token volume for the POC in the quote; RevOps needs the 95th percentile monthly estimate to approve the flat cap.
Lauren SE: I'll draft the capped PO for two weeks and include an optional add-on line for Dedicated (if KMS/mTLS required).
Priya N: I'll own the eval harness runs and produce a short report: side-by-side examples, metric grid (semantic score / token counts / latency), and a list of edge-case failures. Target: initial report within 5 business days of kickoff.
Anya Sec: I'll coordinate the questionnaire review and run a high-level threat model. Please ask SunrisePayments to upload their security questionnaire via our secure uploader (SFTP link) or send via their CISO.
Diego M: Owners: Lauren (commercial), Priya (tech/eval), Anya (security). I'll ping SunrisePayments for prompt samples and the questionnaire now. Anything else?
Lauren SE: One last thing — streaming chunking behavior differs: CompetitorLambda streams partial tokens in chunks of 256; Redwood streams smaller chunks and supports streaming deltas. We'll include a compatibility note and sample WS frames.
Priya N: Noted; we'll include a small adapter snippet for teams that rely on chunk sizes.
Diego M: Great, thanks everyone — I'll set the kickoff for Monday and share the invite. :rocket:
